title: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2): Metacritic user score 9.6 from 5,668 ratings beside the critics' Metascore 96 (read 15:35 Dubai)
game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo Switch 2)
why: New fact only: the players' score beside the critics' (the critics' numbers already ran on 6 Nov).

sources.name: Metacritic game page, Nintendo Switch 2 (release date Nov 5, 2026)

first_report: Metacritic page, read by me 8 Nov 2026 about 11:35Z (15:35 Dubai); the scout read it about 15:20 Dubai (5,635 ratings then). User reviews on the page are dated 4 to 8 Nov 2026.
footage: Nintendo store 'Available Now' trailer for Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 (assets.nintendo.com, 1280x720, three official videos on the store page, all 720p; Nintendo's YouTube is refused without sign-in), clean stretch 8 to 24 s; closing official store screenshot (1920x1080). 720p cannot fill 9:16 inside the 2x cap, so the showcase layout (CLAUDE.md point 5 of 8 Nov) is used for the trailer shots.

claims.text: User Score 9.6 (Universal Acclaim) from 5,668 user ratings: 96% positive (5,435), 1% mixed (78), 3% negative (155)
Metascore 96 (Universal Acclaim), based on 87 critic reviews on the Switch 2 section (the 'All Platforms' section says 90 critic reviews; the Reel uses 87, the Switch 2 figure)
Platform Nintendo Switch 2, release date Nov 5, 2026
NOT claimed: highest ever, review-bombing, any trend (unconfirmed); the page has no times, so the read time (15:35 Dubai) is ours

gate: gate 11:40Z: Metacritic page fetched and read (WebFetch, scores, counts, split, platform, dates). The page cannot be read for an update/correction note (aggregator). Exit A for what is on screen with the read time; user scores move.

director_check.note: Director QA (sonnet) on strip, dense, sheet. First frame: Link from the official trailer in the showcase layout, headline in the top band, chip clear of the grid corner. Shots: 0 showcase hook PASS; 1 score card beat 1 (players alone) over dimmed moving trailer PASS; 2 card beat 2 (players beside critics, read time 15:35 Dubai on it) PASS; 3 and 4 showcase with the positive/negative split lines in the bottom band PASS (shot 4 opens on a dark trailer moment, accepted); 5 official store screenshot, Link on Epona, game image not a card, PASS. Reel 18.2 s before end card, changes every 2.4 to 3.6 s, last 2 s a game image. Known deviation from the 8 Nov showcase rule: the headline is on screen only the first 3.5 s (reel.py head_secs), so the top band is empty in shots 3 and 4 (a persistent headline needs code, flagged to the coordinator). Quality: all three official Nintendo store videos are 1280x720 (YouTube refused), so showcase used; lowbit flag expected. Sound: the trailer's own stretch 8 to 24 s as one continuous track, no added effects, judged from the build not by ear, runner speech check passed. Grammar stage: no required edits.

dl.headline:
لعبة Ocarina of Time
اللاعبون يوافقون النقاد
lines:
صدرت اللعبة على Switch 2
في 5 نوفمبر
dl.ig:
تقييم اللاعبين للعبة The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time على Switch 2 يبلغ 9.6 من 10 على ميتاكريتيك (Metacritic).

الرقم مبني على 5,668 تقييمًا من المستخدمين: نسبة الإيجابي منها 96 بالمئة، والمتوسط 1 بالمئة، والسلبي 3 بالمئة.

أما تقييم النقاد (Metascore) على الموقع نفسه فيبلغ 96 من 100، حسب 87 مراجعة لنسخة Switch 2.

تتغير تقييمات اللاعبين مع وصول تقييمات جديدة، وقد قُرئت الأرقام في صفحة اللعبة حتى 15:35 بتوقيت دبي يوم 8 نوفمبر 2026.

صدرت اللعبة على Nintendo Switch 2 في 5 نوفمبر 2026.

#ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #OcarinaOfTime #Switch2
